sourceNote: Ideas for AI agents operating on Sui. Aligned with the Agentic Web core track at Sui Overflow 2026. Each idea involves an autonomous or semi-autonomous agent that transacts on-chain.

ideas.title: AI content moderator for Sui social apps
ideas.summary: Agent that reviews user-generated content on Sui social apps. Flags violations, produces moderation receipts on-chain. Appeals tracked as Sui objects.
ideas.fitForSui: Nautilus TEE runs moderation models. Sui objects store moderation decisions transparently. Capabilities scope moderation authority.
ideas.marketSignal: Content moderation is a $10B+ market. Decentralized social needs trustless, auditable moderation.

ideas.title: AI customer support agent for Sui dapps
ideas.summary: Agent answers user questions about on-chain activity, explains transaction results, and guides through protocol interactions. Conversation history on Walrus.
ideas.fitForSui: Agent reads on-chain state directly via Sui RPC. Sponsored transactions handle user actions. Walrus stores conversation history.
ideas.marketSignal: AI customer support (Intercom, Zendesk AI) is a $5B+ market. Web3 support is overwhelmingly manual.

ideas.title: Decentralized data labeling network with AI quality checks
ideas.summary: Human labelers annotate data stored on Walrus. AI agent verifies label quality. Payments released on quality threshold. Extends data marketplace pattern with labor.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores datasets and labels. Nautilus TEE runs quality verification. Sui escrow objects hold payments until quality confirmed.
ideas.marketSignal: Scale AI valued at $14B for data labeling. Decentralized alternatives (Sapien) are nascent.

ideas.title: DeFi yield optimizer agent with autonomous rebalancing
ideas.summary: Agent monitors Sui DeFi rates, auto-rebalances deposits across Scallop, NAVI, and Suilend for optimal yield. All moves verifiable on-chain.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs execute multi-protocol rebalancing atomically. Agent's capability limits its spending authority.
ideas.marketSignal: Yearn-style yield optimization manages $1B+ TVL. Autonomous agents add zero-touch convenience.

ideas.title: AI governance delegate that votes based on policy rules
ideas.summary: Token holders delegate votes to an AI agent with explicit policy preferences. Agent analyzes proposals and votes according to delegator-defined rules.
ideas.fitForSui: Capabilities express delegation authority. Sui objects store voting policies. Agent reads proposals and votes via PTBs.
ideas.marketSignal: Governance participation is below 10% on most DAOs. Delegation to informed agents could increase participation.

ideas.title: AI-powered liquidation keeper for Sui lending protocols
ideas.summary: Agent monitors health factors across Scallop, NAVI, and Suilend. Executes profitable liquidations via PTBs. Profit shared with protocol.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs execute liquidation plus swap in one atomic transaction. Pyth feeds trigger the agent.
ideas.marketSignal: Liquidation keepers are essential DeFi infrastructure. $500M+ liquidated monthly across all chains.

ideas.title: AI agent that audits Move packages before deployment
ideas.summary: Agent analyzes Move bytecode for common vulnerabilities, access control issues, and upgrade safety. Produces attestation objects on-chain.
ideas.fitForSui: Nautilus TEE runs the audit in a trusted environment. Sui objects store audit attestations. Composable with deployment flows.
ideas.marketSignal: Manual audits cost $50K+ and take weeks. Automated pre-audit reduces risk and speeds deployment.

ideas.title: News sentiment trading agent for Sui tokens
ideas.summary: Agent monitors news feeds and social media for Sui ecosystem sentiment. Executes trades on DeepBook based on sentiment analysis. Track record on-chain.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook provides on-chain CLOB for trading. Nautilus TEE runs sentiment models. Sui objects track performance.
ideas.marketSignal: Sentiment-based trading is a $1B+ quantitative strategy category. AI makes it accessible to retail.

ideas.title: AI NFT appraisal agent with on-chain valuation reports
ideas.summary: Agent analyzes NFT rarity, historical sales, and market trends to produce valuation reports. Reports stored as Sui objects usable by lending protocols.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects represent appraisal reports composable with other protocols. Kiosk data provides sales history.
ideas.marketSignal: NFT lending protocols need reliable appraisals. Upshot and NFTBank prove demand on EVM.

ideas.title: AI onboarding agent that teaches Sui to new developers
ideas.summary: Agent that answers Move questions, generates scaffold code, explains error messages, and links to relevant docs. Learns from developer interactions stored on Walrus.
ideas.fitForSui: Agent reads Sui documentation and codebase context. Walrus stores interaction history. Sui objects track developer progress.
ideas.marketSignal: Developer onboarding is the top barrier to ecosystem growth. AI tutors (GitHub Copilot) have 1M+ users.

ideas.title: AI portfolio advisor for Sui DeFi positions
ideas.summary: Agent analyzes user's on-chain portfolio, recommends diversification, warns about concentration risk, and suggests rebalancing actions.
ideas.fitForSui: Agent reads all user positions from Sui RPC. Recommendations executable via PTBs. No off-chain data sharing needed.
ideas.marketSignal: Robo-advisors (Betterment, Wealthfront) manage $500B+. On-chain portfolio advice is a green field.

ideas.title: AI agent that trades based on social signals from Sui community
ideas.summary: Agent monitors Sui Twitter, Discord, and on-chain social signals. Identifies trending tokens and executes trades. Transparent strategy and track record.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook provides on-chain CLOB. Nautilus TEE runs social analysis. All trades are verifiable.
ideas.marketSignal: Social trading and meme coin trading bots are a multi-billion category. Sui's growing social ecosystem creates opportunity.

ideas.title: AI tax reporting agent for Sui transactions
ideas.summary: Agent reads on-chain transaction history, classifies events for tax purposes, and generates tax reports. Handles DeFi, NFTs, staking, and airdrops.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's object model makes transaction classification more precise than account-based chains. Full history readable via RPC.
ideas.marketSignal: Koinly and CoinTracker serve millions of users. Sui-specific tax tools are nonexistent.

ideas.title: Autonomous treasury management agent for DAOs
ideas.summary: Agent manages DAO treasury per governance-approved policy. Rebalances holdings, earns yield, and reports monthly. All actions are on-chain and auditable.
ideas.fitForSui: Capabilities limit agent's authority to governance-approved actions. PTBs execute treasury operations atomically.
ideas.marketSignal: DAO treasuries hold $25B+ but most sit idle in stablecoins. Active management is a known need.

ideas.title: AI whale tracking agent with position analysis
ideas.summary: Agent monitors large wallet movements on Sui. Analyzes whale trading patterns, produces weekly reports, and sends alerts for unusual activity.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's object model makes whale position tracking per-object. Agent reads state directly from RPC.
ideas.marketSignal: Whale Alert and Nansen whale tracking have millions of followers. No Sui-specific whale intelligence tool exists.

ideas.title: AI grant proposal writer for Sui ecosystem funds
ideas.summary: Agent analyzes project repos, generates grant proposals tailored to Sui Foundation criteria, and tracks application status. Learns from successful proposals.
ideas.fitForSui: Agent reads on-chain project metrics. Walrus stores proposal drafts. Sui objects track submission and review state.
ideas.marketSignal: Sui Foundation and ecosystem funds distribute millions annually. Grant writing is a bottleneck for small teams.

ideas.title: AI market maker for NFT collections on Kiosk
ideas.summary: Agent provides buy-side liquidity for NFT collections. Prices NFTs using ML models trained on rarity and sales data. Executes via Kiosk.
ideas.fitForSui: Kiosk provides the trading venue. Agent's capabilities scope its spending authority. All bids and purchases verifiable.
ideas.marketSignal: NFT liquidity is the #1 pain point for collectors. Blur's bidding pools proved market-making demand.

ideas.title: AI risk scoring agent for Sui DeFi protocols
ideas.summary: Agent continuously evaluates Sui DeFi protocols for risk factors: TVL concentration, admin key exposure, oracle dependency, smart contract complexity. Publishes scores on-chain.
ideas.fitForSui: Agent reads protocol state directly from Sui RPC. Risk scores stored as Sui objects composable with other DeFi protocols.
ideas.marketSignal: DeFi Safety and Gauntlet serve institutional DeFi users. Automated risk scoring is essential for TVL growth.

ideas.title: AI-powered transaction routing agent for optimal gas and execution
ideas.summary: Agent analyzes transaction intent and routes through the optimal path: which DEXs, which pools, what order. Saves users gas and improves execution quality.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs enable complex multi-step routes in one transaction. Agent optimizes the PTB structure for minimal cost.
ideas.marketSignal: Jupiter's smart routing on Solana is the #1 value proposition. AI can further optimize beyond static algorithms.

ideas.title: AI translation agent for Sui ecosystem documentation
ideas.summary: Agent translates Sui docs, Move tutorials, and protocol documentation into multiple languages. Stores translations on Walrus. Community votes on quality.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores translated docs. Sui objects track translation quality votes. Capabilities scope translator authority.
ideas.marketSignal: Sui ecosystem has global reach but English-only docs. Localization is a known growth bottleneck.
